source.dashboard: Tec Visual Vocabulary > Visual Vocabulary > Correlation
source.how: REST definition + instance JSON (setCurrentPanel on a guest instance), nothing saved

examples.title: Scatter Plot
examples.visualCues: one dot per item on two numeric axes, all dots the same size and color, a thin straight trend line through them

settings.dotSize: SizeType Manual, SizeValue 0.15 (fixed size, no Size By)
settings.trendLine: stored on the X metric in the template: mx[Cost].mdls.mod_c = [{ tp: 257 (trend line), lv: 1, la: -1, incl: 0, cst: { vt: 8, vv: '2' }, fms: { trdRefLnThk: 1, trdRefLnClr: 5066061 (BGR = #4D4D4D), trdRefLnStyle: 0 }, enabl: 1 }]. The server computes a hidden TrendLine_DM_<metric>_1_1 metric (linear, R2 0.97 on the demo).

examples.title: Combo Chart
examples.visualCues: bars for one metric and a line for another, each on its own y-axis (left and right)

settings.lineSeries: metricShapes { <Profit id>: 2 } turns that metric into a line (others stay bars)
settings.dualAxis: the line metric sits on the right axis (drop-zone ax 1); with Metric Names on Rows and Color By, both share one plot
settings.labels: xAxLbNestedLabel true (Quarter, Year nested), xAxLbWrapText true
settings.note: on the demo the Profit line is flat because Profit isn't split by quarter in that dataset

examples.title: Bubble Chart
examples.visualCues: dots of different sizes and three colors on two numeric axes, semi-transparent, thin borders

settings.transparency: allShpFmt { shpFillTrans: 70, shpBdrCmbStyle: 1, shpBdrThk: 1 }, plus per-element fmtOnComb { shpFillTrans: 80 }
settings.elementColors: dashboard-level Category - Correlation: Furniture #E9D39B, Office Supplies #735E2A, Technology #BFAD80

examples.title: Matrix Bar Chart
examples.visualCues: a grid of solid colored squares: attribute A across the top, attribute B down the side, three shades from light to dark, no axis numbers

settings.trick: no metric on the X axis, so every bar fills its cell; Color By Revenue carries the value
settings.borders: allShpFmt shpBdrThk 0 (no bar borders), white gaps between cells
settings.axes: xAxTtShw false, yAxTtShw true, colHdrShw true

commonFormatting.page: free-form, light blue-gray background, CORRELATION heading in sand, title + one-line description above each chart

helpers.trendLine(vizKey, metricId, {model, colo: Format > Trend Line > Enable: act operateTRFLine { tks, lineType 257 linear | 256 best fit, lineLevel 1, enabled 1, includeBreakby 1, lineConstant 2, lineIndex 1, format '{"trdRefLnThk":1,...}', metricId (the plotted Y metric) }
helpers.metricThresholds(..., 'percent'): 'Lowest %' basis = thresholdType 1 with 0-100 bands (value basis is 7)
helpers.fillZones ax: a field with ax: 1 goes on the right axis (editor: right-click metric > Right Axis)

buildFromCode.dualAxisCombo: line metric on YAxis with ax: 1 + Metric Names on Rows AND Color By + metricShapes {'@pLd<lineMetric>':2}. Without the right axis the two metrics draw as two stacked panels.
buildFromCode.verified: 2026-11-10 on Shared Studio › Business Insurance Claims Analytics: 'zz Correlation Showcase v2' (My Reports) built in 4.7 s: Initial Reserve x Payment by State Code with a linear trend line; Payment Amount bars + Claim Count line on a right axis by quarter; bubbles by Customer Segment x Region sized by Claim Count; Customer Segment x Region squares in three percentile shades.
buildFromCode.notYet: Scatter dot color: the build leaves the default blue; the demo's dots are sand (a metric/palette color).
